issues.detail: SI5 text says 2-bromo pentene but product drawing and C22 formula show isopropenyl addition. SI10 text says isobutylchloride but S22 ketone drawing requires isobutyryl chloride. Drawn structures retained.
issues.subject: reagent names

issues.detail: SI36 HRMS printed formula omits N; S26 omits B. Graph and exact mass identify C47H57NO9 and C31H39BO4.
issues.subject: 36,S26

issues.detail: Several auxiliary, preliminary aldol and hemiacetal branch assignments remain pending. Final 1 absolute 2S3S5R7R8S source SI50 is explicitly assigned.
issues.subject: early aldol and auxiliary

issues.detail: SI4 preparation reports er8:1, SI5 consumption says er>20:1 without enrichment operation; no unreported purification invented.
Future Liebeskind route has undefined R thioester and no detailed preparation, excluded from definitive reaction network.
issues.subject: SI50

issues.detail: Parallel ent structures are drawn; yields only explicitly reported for unprefixed procedure and are not copied to ent branch.
issues.subject: ent-5/6/7
